sources.snippet: OpenWhispr 1.10.0 ships Orukeet as its recommended local model. In the local model picker, choose Oruk → Orukeet and download the model. This integration uses the ONNX export through OpenWhispr's existing sherpa-onnx runtime. Follow the file-upload walkthrough for the exact settings and a public sample with its observed transcript. sources.title: orukeet by Oruk: Open-Weight Model
sources.snippet: orukeet is an open-weight model for speech recognition from Oruk, released under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. It has 627M parameters. At 16-bit it needs about 1.5 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 1x MI300X from $1.85 an hour, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index. It draws 10.6k downloads a month.

sources.title: orukeet: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview orukeet is a 25-language automatic speech recognition model from Oruk AI, maintained by oruk. It is built from NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and retains its 627,008,134 parameters, 24-layer FastConformer encoder, token-and-duration transducer, and tokenizer.
